intro.para1: SeaZen is a light-filled seafront penthouse in the old center of Sitges — one of Spain's most beloved coastal towns. Perched above the promenade with uninterrupted sea views, every detail has been considered for those who appreciate quality and peace of mind.
intro.para2: Whether you're seeking a romantic escape, a family retreat, or a creative recharge, SeaZen offers the perfect base to experience the best of the Catalan coast.

floorplan.heading: 110 m² of refined space
floorplan.desc: One bedroom, open-plan living, fully equipped kitchen, and a sea-facing huge terrace.

hero.subtitle: Sitges (Barcelona) - seafront luxury penthouse - direct from the owner
hero.subtext: A private penthouse with uninterrupted sea views, designed for those who appreciate the art of doing nothing.

items.name: Thomas
items.text:
This is a perfect unit to enjoy the absolute best of Sitges.

The unit is breathtakingly beautiful, fully stocked with everything we needed. The deck is stunning. The location is the best in town. It is hard to image a better property in all of Sitges. We enjoyed every minute in this property.

items.name: Steve
items.text:
Location Location Location that is what this property is all about,

Stunning 180 Deg Views and large terrace make this property an exceptional place to stay.
